title: App Sentinel
description:
An agentic mobile-application security assessment platform. You give it an Android APK you own or are authorized to assess; it analyzes the app, maps the backend it talks to, and — only within an authorized scope — runs safe, evidence-based checks against that backend, producing findings it can prove.

It is built around one idea:
The LLM proposes. Deterministic code decides and proves.

The AI reasons about what to test next, but a plain, testable scope gate authorizes every action and a separate verifier judges the real result. The model can't grant itself permission, and it can't be talked out of the rules by a prompt injection hidden in an app — because the security decisions never read the model's output.

⚠️ Local, single-operator prototype. Only assess applications and backends you own or are explicitly authorized to test. A completed assessment does not mean an app is secure.
